Social Media Manager Job at Scentimental




        
    

        
        Scentimental is a luxury home fragrance and lifestyle brand inspired by nostalgia, travel, and storytelling.

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position:  Social Media Manager

Job Location: Lagos, Nigeria
Employment Type: Full-time
Work arrangement: Hybrid

Job Description


	Are you passionate about storytelling, building engaged communities, and using social media to drive business growth?
	We’re looking for a commercially minded Social Media Manager to strengthen our social media presence across Nigeria and the UK.


What you’ll do
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Manage our social media calendar and day-to-day publishing across relevant platforms.
	Translate brand and marketing priorities into engaging content plans.
	Write compelling captions and adapt content for different platforms and audiences.
	Manage community engagement, comments, DMs, and customer queries.
	Coordinate campaigns, product launches, influencer collaborations, and user-generated content.
	Track performance and use insights to improve reach, engagement, audience growth, and conversions.
	Stay on top of relevant trends while maintaining Scentimental’s premium brand identity.


What we’re looking for


	3+ years of social media management experience, ideally with a lifestyle, luxury, beauty, fashion, or consumer brand.
	Strong copywriting, storytelling, planning, and execution skills.
	Experience managing Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok.
	An understanding of social media analytics and how to connect content with commercial results.
	A proactive, organised individual with excellent attention to detail.


Method of Applictaion 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and a brief introductory email to: [email protected] and copy [email protected] using "Social Media Manager" as the subject of the email.
